R596.note: Removing @csrf_exempt restores CsrfViewMiddleware enforcement; 405/401/queued paths untouched and the middleware-present assumption is stated.

R597.note: random_bytes(32)/bin2hex replaces the attacker-seeded mt_rand; the numeric-to-64-hex token format change is stated, though a narrow integer reset_token column would need widening.

R598.note: ValidAlgorithms pinned to HS256 is the correct allowlist for this sink; the assumption that the issuer signs with HS256 (not HS384/HS512) is stated openly.

R599.note: Real-path check on the created parent closes the symlink write vector and createDirectories is stated and required by the nested-entry contract; nit: directories are created before the real-path check runs, so a symlinked parent can still get empty dirs made outside the root.

R600.note: Single-segment plus canonical-parent check closes traversal and absolute paths, but dropping URLDecoder.decode breaks the documented legacy double-encoding clients while the write-up calls the decode merely redundant; validating after the decode would have closed the vector without that regression.

R601.note: Replacing the shell with java.io.File removes the injection entirely, but the fix adds a CWD-containment restriction that rejects paths the original listed (e.g. /tmp) and changes output to System.out; stated, so 1.

R602.note: Parameterized QueryRow with ? placeholder; only caveat is the stated MySQL/SQLite placeholder assumption (Postgres would need $1).

R603.note: Generic client message with the wrapped error logged server-side; status code and success path unchanged.

R604.note: .RequireAuthorization() attaches per-endpoint metadata matching the controller's [Authorize]; no other change.

R605.note: Jakarta Mail getFolder/open(READ_WRITE) issues SELECT with CR/LF folder names sent as IMAP literals, closing the injection, but the method signature changes (Socket->Store, void->Folder) so every existing caller breaks and open() now throws on a missing folder; the signature change is stated, the new exception path is not.

R606.note: Build fails: BasicAuthenticationFilter is imported from org.springframework.security.authentication.www instead of org.springframework.security.web.authentication.www, so the config does not compile; the intended SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler/CsrfCookieFilter design otherwise matches Spring's documented SPA pattern.
